{/* Animated Watermark Background */}
NET_SENTINEL
{/* HERO SECTION */}
SYSTEM SEC_OPS ACTIVE

NETSENTINEL SOC INTELLIGENCE SUITE

A modular threat intelligence platform engineered for real-time network probes, host telemetry resolution, active CVE vulnerability detection, and exposed asset audits.

{/* ABOUT PROJECT SECTION */}

PROJECT ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN PURPOSE

NetSentinel SOC was built to provide security analysts and administrators with direct visibility into external network footprints. By combining five specialized reconnaissance engines into a responsive React frontend backed by secure Node.js services, operators can execute live target assessments with zero simulated mock delay.

⚡ Live API Pipeline

Queries live authoritative endpoints including Shodan InternetDB, ip-api, and certificate logs.

🛡️ Auth Gate Protection

Requires authenticated analyst sessions before executing any security probe.

📊 Audit Logging

Persists scan results locally and allows instant JSON vulnerability report exports.

{/* TOOL MODULES SECTION WITH UNIQUE IDS FOR HEADER SLIDING */}

RECONNAISSANCE TOOL MODULES

Click any tool card below (or via the header navigation) to authenticate and execute a live probe.

{/* Tool 1 */}
handleToolClick('host_info')}>

1. Domain Host & IP Geolocation Intel

Resolves target domain names to IPv4 addresses. Fetches ASN details, internet service providers (ISP), country/city geolocations, and network registry data.

AUTHENTICATE & RUN HOST PROBE
{/* Tool 2 */}
handleToolClick('port_threat')}>

2. Port Scanner & CVE Threat Evaluator

Queries Shodan InternetDB to uncover open network ports (HTTP, SSH, FTP, Database ports) and flags known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs).

AUTHENTICATE & RUN PORT PROBE
{/* Tool 3 */}
handleToolClick('subdomain_dns')}>

3. Subdomain Enumerator & DNS Mapping

Performs passive subdomain discovery by analyzing public Certificate Transparency (CT) logs via crt.sh to map active hostnames and DNS records.

AUTHENTICATE & RUN ENUMERATOR
{/* Tool 4 */}
handleToolClick('dir_exposure')}>

4. Directory Bruteforce & Confidential File Probe

Inspects web roots for exposed sensitive files (`.env`, `.git`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`) and flags dangerous HTTP 200 configuration leaks.

AUTHENTICATE & RUN DIRECTORY PROBE
{/* Tool 5 */}
handleToolClick('ssl_audit')}>

5. SSL Certificate & Security Header Auditor

Audits SSL/TLS encryption certificates for validity and verifies defensive HTTP headers like HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and X-Frame-Options.

AUTHENTICATE & RUN HEADER AUDIT
